description: Honest troubleshooting from working appliance technicians, grounded in real completed repairs. Use it when the person describes a broken washer, dryer, refrigerator, freezer, dishwasher, oven, range, cooktop or microwave and wants to know what is wrong or what they can safely check, usually before deciding to book. Returns likely causes, what is safe to check, a safety warning (hazard is true for gas smell, refrigerant, sparks, smoke or burning, which are always pro-only), and next steps. It never returns part numbers or prices for parts. Read-only: it books nothing and contacts no one; it asks our repair knowledge service, so it can take up to about 20 seconds and the wording can vary between calls. If that service is unavailable it still returns the safety note and next steps.

error_code.description: Code shown on the display, if any.

model.description: Model number from the sticker, if known; it sharpens the answer and is never echoed back as a part number.

symptom.description: What is happening, in the person's own words (up to about 600 characters are used).
examples: won't drain and shows water in the tub

name: diagnose_appliance_problem

error.description: Present only when the call could not be completed; says what to fix or who to call.

hazard.description: true when the symptom sounds like a gas, refrigerant or electrical hazard

safety.description: Safety note to read to the person first

title: Diagnose an appliance problem
